exercises.title: Measure the redundancy: how often is each customer's city stored?
exercises.problemHtml:
The update anomaly in numbers: for every customer, how many rows of Order1NF repeat their city? (After 3NF it will be exactly 1 each.)

The 1NF table of lesson 4.4 (tab Order1NF.sql): Order1NF(order_id, order_date, cust_id, cust_name, cust_city, product_id, qty, unit_price), key (order_id, product_id). FDs: order_id → order_date, cust_id · cust_id → cust_name, cust_city · product_id → unit_price · order_id, product_id → qty.

Requirements

  • Columns: cust_id, copies.
  • Row order does not matter.
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
Dị thường cập nhật bằng con số: với mỗi khách hàng, Order1NF lặp thành phố của họ trong bao nhiêu dòng? (Sau 3NF sẽ đúng 1 mỗi người.)

Bảng 1NF của bài 4.4 (tab Order1NF.sql): Order1NF(order_id, order_date, cust_id, cust_name, cust_city, product_id, qty, unit_price), khoá (order_id, product_id). FD: order_id → order_date, cust_id · cust_id → cust_name, cust_city · product_id → unit_price · order_id, product_id → qty.

Yêu cầu

  • Cột: cust_id, copies.
  • Thứ tự dòng không quan trọng.

exercises.title: Which step removes which dependency?
exercises.problemHtml:
Follow lesson 4.4 on the order table. For each change, say which step (normal form) it belongs to.

This set has 1 table. There is nothing to run: answer in the panel on the right and press Submit. Work each one out yourself first (on paper, or in SSMS on your own SQL Server), then check — every explanation after Submit says why the tempting wrong answer is wrong.

Requirements

solutionCodeJson.name: answers.md
solutionCodeJson.code:
# Read the final schema — answer key

1. Key of OrderLine?Khoá của OrderLine?
   Answer: a) (order_id, product_id)
   One line per product per order.VI: Mỗi đơn mỗi sản phẩm một dòng.

2. Why is Order ⋈ OrderLine lossless?Vì sao Order ⋈ OrderLine không mất?
   Answer: a) their common attribute order_id is the key of Order
   Shared attribute = key of one side ⇒ lossless.VI: Thuộc tính chung = khoá của một phía ⇒ không mất.

3. A new customer with no order yet can now be stored because…Khách mới chưa có đơn giờ lưu được vì…
   Answer: b) Customer has its own table keyed by cust_id
   The insertion anomaly is gone.VI: Dị thường chèn đã hết.

4. Is the final schema in BCNF?Lược đồ cuối có ở BCNF?
   Answer: c) Yes — every determinant is the key of its table
   cust_id → … lives in Customer where cust_id is the key.VI: cust_id → … nằm trong Customer, nơi cust_id là khoá.
